version: 1.0 (Phase 3H / Batch D, declared before the first manual run)
status_of_this_document: DECLARED BEFORE THE MANUAL RUN. Comparison plan for the documented daily-lag layer of the archived V1.4 programme: XYD (1,416 crude daily-lag tests), DAY (1,416 adjusted single-day regressions) and MAXT (240 max-|r| permutation statistics). Numerical reproduction, independent verification and the assessment of the permutation assumptions are separate statuses. Nothing here is derived from a result of this run; no seed is invented (the MAXT seed rule is traced to the legacy code). Separate from the nine final L01-L56 models (V2.1); horizon L01-L59 (archived).

scope.day: R/070_cumulative_models.R siecc_single_day_adjusted_grid; stage 07_single_day_adjusted_grid (primary model tier M2_L)
scope.kept_separate_from: the nine final L01-L56 DLMs; archived L01-L59 DLM and lag-form sensitivity (Phase 3E); cold burden (Phase 3F); no archived result is combined with a final model

XYD.exposures: the eight metrics' daily fields <prefix>_L01..L59 (UTCI, MRT, T2M, RH, IMS_IDW_TD_MEAN, IMS_IDW_RH_MEAN, IMS_IDW_RAIN_TOTAL, IMS_IDW_RAIN_DAYS1), each lag separately (no cumulation)
XYD.missing_data: pairs with finite outcome and exposure only; fewer than 4 pairs or a constant variable gives NA; the supplied rainfall missingness is preserved (the single missing rainfall total at lag 35 gives n = 54 for the three IMS_rainfall_total L35 tests, 55 elsewhere)
XYD.statistics: n; Pearson r (point-biserial for the 0/1 outcome) and its t p value (stats::cor.test); Spearman rho and p (exact = FALSE); Kendall tau and p (exact = FALSE); M0 regression of the outcome on the exposure alone (tier 'M0_XY', no covariates): coefficient, 95% CI, p, R2, adjusted R2, Nagelkerke R2 (binary), odds ratio per SD (binary), partial R2; status; fitting: OLS with HC3 inference (gaussian), ordinary ML logistic with Wald inference (binary; glm default control epsilon 1e-8 / maxit 25)
XYD.multiplicity: BH q_pearson_global, q_spearman_global, q_model_global over all 1,416 tests; q_*_outcome within outcome (3 families of 472); there are no within-outcome-metric families in the daily scan (unlike the cumulative scan)

DAY.model: outcome ~ exposure + M2_L covariates (Sex, Age, AssessmentDay_centered, Locality_3group, Econ_STS); raw daily exposure on its natural scale (transformation 'raw_daily', exposure_unit the metric's unit); complete cases on outcome, covariates and the single daily exposure (n = 54 for the rainfall-total L35 models, 55 elsewhere); gaussian HC3 / binary ML Wald as in the cumulative engine (epsilon 1e-8, maxit 25); the 13 design and influence diagnostics of the validated engine; no Firth column is part of the frozen output
DAY.multiplicity: q59: BH over the 59 lags within outcome x metric (24 families); q472: BH over 8 x 59 within outcome (3 families); q_global: BH over all 1,416; over finite p values

MAXT.family_structure: TRACED from the code, not inferred from the row count: for each of the 3 outcomes separately, the 80 CUMULATIVE exposure fields (8 metrics x 10 windows 1,3,7,14,21,28,35,42,49,56 days; field names <cumulative prefix><window>D, in the order of the cumulative XY scan) = 3 x 80 = 240 statistics; the maximum is taken within one outcome over its 80 fields; no adjustment across outcomes; the daily-lag exposures are NOT part of MAXT
MAXT.statistic_and_hypothesis: two-sided: |Pearson r| of each exposure with the outcome using stats::cor(use = 'pairwise.complete.obs') (point-biserial for the 0/1 outcome); no covariates (crude test); H0: the outcome is independent of all 80 exposures; single-step maxT (Westfall-Young type)
MAXT.permutation: the OUTCOME vector is permuted across participants with sample(y) (unit: participant; unrestricted: no stratification by assessment date or covariates); the exposure columns are kept fixed
MAXT.replicates: 10,000 requested per outcome (V1.4 full profile, config maxT_replicates); the maximum of a replicate is max(|r|, na.rm = TRUE); a replicate is 'successful' if the maximum is finite; the original does not store the number of successes
MAXT.seed_and_rng: set.seed(config seed + 1000 x outcome index) immediately before the replicate loop; seed = 20260729 + 1000 x i with i = 1 (UCLA_Lonliness_SCORE), 2 (Isolation_cont), 3 (Int_dummy) = 20261729, 20262729, 20263729; one sample(y) per replicate and no other RNG use; R 4.4.3 defaults (Mersenne-Twister, Inversion, Rejection); the package sets the RNG kinds explicitly and restores the caller's state
MAXT.adjusted_p: p_j = (1 + #{replicates with max >= observed_j}) / (1 + #{replicates with a finite max}); ties count (>=); the observed arrangement is counted as one permutation (finite-simulation correction); minimum attainable p = 1/10,001
MAXT.degenerate_cases: constant or all-missing exposure: correlation NA, dropped from the maximum; a replicate with no finite correlation has maximum -Inf and is not counted as successful; an observed statistic that is NA makes every comparison NA, which the original drops, giving that statistic the smallest attainable p (anti-conservative; flagged by the assessment, not changed)
MAXT.limitations_to_assess_not_to_change: unrestricted participant permutation ignores clustering of outcomes by the 33 assessment dates (exchangeability); no covariate adjustment; |r| statistics with different n (54 vs 55) are compared on one scale; the 80 statistics are nested and dependent; the Monte Carlo error of p is about 0.005 at p = 0.5; the manuscript does not describe this test (SI Table S5 / notes only)

XYD_DAY.source: config/sieccwinter_config.json tolerances (same fitting engine as the validated cumulative grid)

MAXT.rule: the permutation test is reproduced with the original seed and sampling sequence, so the statistics and p values must be EXACT (counts k/10,001); a difference is DIFFERENT and fails; a Monte Carlo-consistency comparison would be reported separately and would NOT replace the exact criterion

verification.XYD: all 1,416 rows recomputed independently: Pearson (formula, t p), Spearman (Pearson on average ranks, t approximation), Kendall tau-b with its tie-corrected normal approximation (own code), M0 regression (own formulas, own Newton logistic) at relative tolerance 1e-6; q families recomputed with p.adjust BH
verification.DAY: scale and inference identities over all estimable models for the package and the frozen file; q59 / q472 / q_global recomputed with p.adjust BH; independent formula-based refit of a deterministic sample (every 40th model in result order: 36 of 1,416)
verification.MAXT: the optimised engine is compared with the ORIGINAL cor-based route run on the same seeds for all 3 x 10,000 replicates (maxima to 1e-12; identical p); replicate requested / successful / near-tie recomputations are reported per outcome
verification.MAXT_assumptions: assessed separately and reported as REVIEW (never PASS): exchangeability (between-date share of outcome variance), unequal n across statistics, observed-NA handling, Monte Carlo error, attainable minimum, share of p = 1; the original method is not replaced

statuses.INPUT_PROVENANCE_STATUS: PASS only if all three reference files exist with the declared SHA-256 and bytes, record counts, unique keys, required columns and the MAXT grid (3 outcomes x 80); otherwise FAIL and nothing is compared
statuses.XYD_REPRODUCTION_STATUS: PASS only if 27,848 declared cells have no DIFFERENT / NONFINITE / UNMATCHED / unclassified cell and the categorical fields are identical
statuses.XYD_VERIFICATION_STATUS: PASS only if every independent quantity and q family agrees
statuses.DAY_VERIFICATION_STATUS: PASS only if identities, multiplicity and the sampled refit all pass
statuses.MAXT_REPRODUCTION_STATUS: PASS only if all 480 cells are EXACT
statuses.MAXT_VERIFICATION_STATUS: PASS only if the optimised and original routes agree for every replicate
statuses.COVERAGE_STATUS: PASS only if every required comparison is present, classified and complete
statuses.SOURCE_INTEGRITY_STATUS: PASS only if the source fingerprint is unchanged during the run
statuses.carried_unchanged: FINAL_NINE_L56 = ACCEPTED_UNDER_V2_1; ARCHIVED_DLM_DETERMINISTIC = ACCEPTED_PHASE3E1; COLD_BURDEN_NUMERICAL = ACCEPTED_PHASE3F1; MANUSCRIPT_CONCORDANCE = REVIEW; FIGURE_PROVENANCE = NOT_TESTED; DLNM_EQUALITY = NOT_TESTED; J02 (glm epsilon entry points) = OPEN

exit_codes.0: all statuses PASS and nothing open (not expected: MAXT assumptions stay REVIEW)
exit_codes.3: all reproduction and verification statuses PASS with MAXT assumptions under REVIEW (expected best case)
exit_codes.4: a status FAILED or evidence is missing
